data.title: Ran Xia
data.synopsis:
Having defeated the invincible legend, the new junior sister apprentice must not be simple. Shen Dong, once the most powerful apprentice of the sect, simply wants to live a stable life, but Xia Ri breaks his peaceful life. Xia Ri makes trouble everywhere and seems to be perverse and unruly, but she's actually a kind and warm person. Shen Dong is gradually influenced and moved by her. The conflicts between the four major sects are constantly escalating. It's time to settle both old and new grudges.

(Source: Bilibili)

data.title: Hero Inside
data.synopsis:
Heroes can pop out of their comic books when summoned in this comedic action-adventure.

The cartoonist Scott mysteriously disappears, leaving behind 100 volumes of superhero comic books that spread throughout San Francisco. The protagonist, Mike, stumbles upon "Crying Man" and ends up summoning the superhero from the book, forever changing his life. But it's not just Mike, but many people begin to summon superheroes from these comic books, leading to a series of events unfolding throughout San Francisco.

title_synonyms: Zhen Dao Ge 2: Jiangjun Xie Yin
data.synopsis:
Following the clues, He Fangzhi and Aya finally found the mastermind behind the murder of Lord Lin. Afterwards, they went to Fengming Mountain, entrusted by the Pavilion Master, to rescue someone in the Northwest… Along the way, He Fangzhi encountered all sorts of people, some in high positions, others in the martial world. Each had their own choices and, in their own way, upheld what they believed in!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Painting Rivers and Lakes: The Legend of Gangster

data.title: Hua Jianghu: Tiangang
title_synonyms: Painting Jianghu: The Legend of Tiangang
Painting Rivers and Lakes: The Legend of Gangster
data.synopsis:
During the reign of Emperor Da Zhou, the political situation was turbulent, and treacherous officials held power. Bu Liang Ren, a secret assassination organization directly under the emperor, suddenly lost its leader overnight, and their chief, Yuan Tiangang, resigned with a letter. Lost and directionless, Yuan Tiangang, guided by a brocade pouch left by his friend Li Chunfeng, arrived at the Anle Pavilion in Chang'an, only to discover it was a brothel. What followed, with the appearance of those seeking freedom, immortality, and power, set a new stage in Yuan Tiangang's journey…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Quan Zhi Ming
data.synopsis:
High school student Longjing is transported to the Ming Clan Continent and taken in by Moli, a girl from the Ming Clan. He discovers he's become the only magician there?! Qi Hong, the young lady betrothed to Moli, Puer, the mischievous eldest son of the Hei family, and Wu Yiyan, the continent's strongest martial artist… all join the adventurer's team one after another. Embark on an adventure, young man! A chaotic and hilarious new world begins! …Wait, why has Moli turned evil?!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
